items.title: Independent externally-anchorable evidence
items.objective: Signed-manifest + hash-chained ledger + offline verifier interface + tamper tests (design only; external anchor HELD)
limitations: real third-party timestamping / write-once storage / production keys HELD

items.title: FounderGate assurance case
items.objective: Claim-evidence graph proving 'this exact candidate is ready for the stated founder review'; JSON + HTML; unsupported-claim detection

items.title: Supply-chain baseline
items.objective: lock/drift checks, minimal SBOM, license register, vuln-scan interface, base-image digest register (scanner execution NOT PROVEN unless local scanner present)
limitations: no vulnerability completeness claim; no SLSA claim

items.title: Agentic threat model + security regression suite
items.objective: Permanent fixtures: policy rewrite, secret request, tool-desc authority change, poisoned memory, privilege expansion, indirect forbidden tool, unauthorized delegation, arg-change-after-approval, cross-SHA evidence, gate self-mod, false success, stale approval replay, wrong machine, duplicate launch, missing checker, altered policy, cost exceeded, corrupt checkpoint

items.title: Memory & context quarantine
items.objective: Separate immutable laws / trusted config / verified evidence / untrusted repo content / user notes / model summaries / chat; provenance+classification+expiry+explicit promotion; no silent promotion

items.title: Secret broker & outbound-data policy
items.objective: Provider-neutral broker contract + deterministic fake broker + task-scoped credential lease; real broker HELD

items.title: Tested recovery & disaster-recovery framework
items.objective: Deterministic fault injection (process death, interrupted write, unavailable stores, corrupt checkpoint, disk-full, partial deletion, stale lock, duplicate supervisor, restart during builder/checker, restart after ACTION_FIRED)

items.title: Outside-operator & second-project proof
items.objective: unrelated repo + non-founder operator + serious design partner + measured burden/support/recovery

items.title: Portable open evidence format v1
items.objective: FounderGate Evidence Spec v1: subject/source/tree/policy/tools/provider-model/actions/refusals/tests/checker/findings/limitations/gate/signatures + canonicalization + sample + tests + HTML

items.title: Policy simulator & change-impact preview
items.objective: pure simulation of affected projects / newly eligible-held / stale approvals / authority delta / risks / rollback; applies NO change

items.title: Proof-coverage matrix
items.objective: honest matrix (not a universal safety score) across identity/build/tests/deps/security/runtime-witness/recovery/load/provider/model/checker-independence/reconciliation/evidence-portability/customer with PROVEN/PARTIAL/NOT-RUN/NOT-PROVEN/HELD/UNKNOWN/STALE/NOT-PASSED; exposed in console

items.title: Reconciliation Inbox
items.objective: founder surface for uncertain effects: action/intent/idempotency/target/dispatch-time/process-state/external-result/reconciliation-status/safe-retry/RESUME-BRANCH-ABANDON; 'will not retry until reconciled'

items.title: Checker diversity register
items.objective: track static/property/mutation/browser/sandbox/independent-model/security-tool/human methods + independence + blind spots; no model-diversity claim when only one model

items.title: Continuous control monitoring (local read-only)
limitations: production monitoring HELD; no OTel dependency

items.title: Model/provider change gates
items.objective: record provider/model/CLI-version/exe-identity/context/tools/system-prompt-digest/policy; material change stales approvals + regression probes + canary + refusal-compare; stop on regression

items.title: Blast-radius budgets
items.objective: per-job max files/lines/branches/worktrees/external-calls/recipients/dollars/records/time/delegation/output; exceed -> stop before further work

items.title: Reversible-first action design
items.objective: action contract states reversible/compensation/undo-window/external-effect/recovery-cost/preview/staged/soft-delete/draft/temp-authority; prefer non-irreversible; real irreversible = TRUE FOUNDER GATE

items.title: Gate-fatigue protection
items.objective: metrics gates-per-run/review-time/repeated-approvals/reversed/unread/comprehension/standing-policy-eligible; no bundling unrelated high-risk approvals

items.title: Evidence redaction & privacy-preserving exports
items.objective: private package + redacted disclosure package; redaction categories + category-removal manifest + before/after digest + reproducibility + private-unchanged proof

items.title: Prove-the-refusal benchmark
items.objective: permanent refusal corpus (wrong SHA/tree, stale approval, missing evidence, unknown side-effect, unauthorized tool, altered policy, untrusted repo instruction, cost exceeded, corrupt checkpoint, wrong machine, duplicate launch, missing checker, expired lease, wrong worktree/branch, protected main, cross-candidate evidence, changed args, provider/model drift)
